meeting.title: Loop Returns weekly sync
meeting.summary: Weekly sync with Loop Returns. Semantic layer is in good shape — return-rate signed off, refund-latency still under debate with finance. The dashboard inventory slipped and is now the long pole because the exec KPI rebuild depends on it. Agreed Derek gets the top-20 Looker inventory over to Vector by Thursday so Sam can start the migration batches. Infosec review is moving; Priya has the SSO metadata request in flight.
action_items: Derek to send the top-20 Looker dashboard inventory to Vector by Thursday
Sofia to close out the refund-latency metric definition with finance this week
Sam to start migration batch 1 once the inventory lands
Priya to confirm the Okta SAML metadata is ready for the SSO configuration
key_decisions: Dashboard inventory is the current critical-path blocker for the exec KPI rebuild
Refund-latency metric stays out of the go-live set until finance signs the definition
meeting.notes: Healthy engagement from all three. Derek is the workhorse; Sofia unblocks decisions fast. Refund-latency is the only definitional debate left and it's a finance question, not a data one.

transcript.speaker: You
transcript.text: Morning all. Quick action-item pass first, then I want to talk about the dashboard inventory because it's starting to block the rebuild.

transcript.speaker: Sofia Marchetti
transcript.text: Good news on metrics — return-rate is signed off. Refund-latency is still going back and forth with finance over whether we count business days or calendar days.

transcript.speaker: You
transcript.text: Let's keep refund-latency out of the go-live set until that's settled — no point migrating a number two teams disagree on. Can you close it this week?

transcript.speaker: Sofia Marchetti
transcript.text: Yes, I'll force the decision in Thursday's finance review.

transcript.speaker: You
transcript.text: Derek, the exec KPI rebuild is waiting on your dashboard inventory — the top 20 we're migrating first. Where's that?

transcript.speaker: Derek Huang
transcript.text: Fair. It slipped because I was heads-down on the CI checks. I can get the top-20 list over by Thursday — I've already got usage stats on which Looker dashboards actually get opened.

transcript.speaker: You
transcript.text: Perfect, usage-ranked is exactly right. The day that lands I'll start migration batch one.

transcript.speaker: Priya Shah
transcript.text: On SSO — I've got the Okta SAML metadata request in with our identity team. Should have it back early next week.

transcript.speaker: You
transcript.text: Great, that keeps SSO off the critical path. Anything blocking any of you from our side?

transcript.speaker: Derek Huang
transcript.text: No, staging access is working well. The compile is clean now.

transcript.speaker: You
transcript.text: Then we're in good shape. Recap and actions to follow — thanks everyone.
